subject: test_decide_rejects_depending_on_itself fails in CI and writes into the repo
body: On PR #24 CI, tools/test_coord.py SelfReferenceTests picks the id from local_decisions() only, but cmd_decide also counts decisions on remote branches (collect()). With D-coord-018 on your branch and not on the checked-out one, the test passes D-coord-018 while decide writes D-coord-019, so CoordError is not raised and a real decision file lands in coord/decisions/coord/. Fix: in the test use known = set(coord.local_decisions()) | set(coord.collect(include_worktree=False)['decisions']) before next_decision_id, and run decide against a temp COORD dir so a failure never writes into the repo.
